cues.heading: Hold your support
cues.text: Stand beside a stable worktop and keep a hand on it.

cues.heading: Lift the other foot
cues.text: Shift onto your exercise leg. Lift the other foot just clear of the floor.

cues.heading: Stay tall and level
cues.text: Keep your pelvis level. Look ahead and keep holding the support.

cues.heading: Put your foot down
cues.text: Gently return your lifted foot to the floor and rest.

cues.heading: Keep support close
cues.text: Do not let go until your physiotherapist says you are ready.

cues.heading: Follow your plan
cues.text: Use your prescribed hold time. Stop if you feel unsteady or dizzy.
